title: MatchWise | Unified Monitoring
description: Unified monitoring for Oracle Cloud infrastructure, Render backend availability, Vercel frontend availability, Pino HTTP application logs, and Render log collector health. Render and Vercel host CPU/RAM metrics are not collected.

panels.title: MatchWise / Operations Center
panels.description: High-level view of all currently collected monitoring data.

options.content:
### MATCHWISE / OPERATIONS CENTER
**Oracle Cloud** · VM CPU, RAM, disk, network and system load  |  **Render** · backend HTTP checks every 30 minutes + Pino application logs  |  **Vercel** · frontend HTTP checks every minute  |  **Log collector** · last successful Render Logs API collection

> **Data coverage:** Host CPU/RAM metrics for the Render and Vercel platforms are **not** collected. Availability panels show the most recently observed probe result, not a continuous availability guarantee. Backend processing time and end-to-end HTTP probe duration are different measurements.

panels.title: Oracle · Node Exporter
panels.description: Last Prometheus scrape of Oracle VM host metrics.

panels.title: Render · Latest HTTP probe
panels.description: Last observed result of the 30-minute Blackbox HTTP probe; 40-minute freshness window.

panels.title: Vercel · Frontend availability
panels.description: Last observed result of the 1-minute Blackbox HTTP probe; 5-minute freshness window.

panels.title: Log collector · Time since last success
panels.description: Elapsed time since a successful Render Logs API collection. The alert threshold is 300 seconds.

panels.title: Oracle · CPU utilization
panels.description: Oracle VM CPU utilization from Node Exporter.

panels.title: Oracle · Memory utilization
panels.description: Oracle VM memory utilization from Node Exporter.

panels.title: Oracle · Root disk utilization
panels.description: Root filesystem utilization on the Oracle VM.

panels.title: Backend · HTTP 5xx errors (selected period)
panels.description: HTTP 5xx responses found in Pino application logs within the selected dashboard time range.

panels.title: Oracle · Uptime
panels.description: Seconds since the Oracle VM last booted.

panels.title: Oracle · Available memory
panels.description: Available system memory, excluding reclaimable/cached memory that is in use.

panels.title: Oracle · Available disk space
panels.description: Available storage on the Oracle VM root filesystem.

panels.title: Oracle · 1-minute load average
panels.description: One-minute system load average.

panels.title: CPU utilization (%)
panels.description: Five-minute moving average of Oracle CPU utilization.

panels.title: Memory utilization (%)
panels.description: Available-based memory utilization, percent of installed RAM.

panels.title: Root filesystem utilization (%)
panels.description: Root filesystem used space percentage.

panels.title: Disk I/O · Read and write throughput
panels.description: Read and write throughput of block devices. Diskstats are recorded by Node Exporter.

panels.title: Network · Receive and transmit traffic
panels.description: Receive/transmit throughput from non-loopback network interfaces (Docker and veth devices excluded).

panels.title: System load · 1m / 5m / 15m
panels.description: Linux 1-, 5- and 15-minute system load averages; a load average is not CPU usage percent.

panels.title: 03 · RENDER | Backend availability and cold starts
Backend · Latest HTTP status code
panels.description: HTTP status code of the most recent Render backend probe (every 30 minutes).

panels.title: Backend · Latest HTTP response time
panels.description: Blackbox total HTTP probe time, including potential Render Free cold starts and network latency.

panels.title: Backend · Successful HTTP probes (%)
panels.description: Share of sampled successful backend probes; not a continuous uptime SLA.

panels.title: Render · HTTP response time (30-minute probes)
panels.description: HTTP probe duration from the Oracle VM; Render Free cold-start latency may be visible.

panels.title: Render · HTTP probe results (0/1)
panels.description: One probe approximately every 30 minutes; discrete probe results are not continuous uptime.

panels.title: 04 · VERCEL | Frontend availability (no host CPU/RAM metrics)
Frontend · Latest HTTP status code
panels.description: HTTP status code of the most recent Vercel frontend probe.

panels.title: Frontend · Latest HTTP response time
panels.description: Duration of the most recent Vercel HTTP probe.

panels.title: Frontend · Successful HTTP probes (%)
panels.description: Share of successful one-minute Vercel probes; not browser Real User Monitoring / Web Vitals.

panels.title: Frontend · HTTP response time history
panels.description: Frontend HTTP probe duration as observed from the Oracle VM.

panels.title: Frontend · HTTP probe results (0/1)
panels.description: Success of each sampled frontend HTTP check.

panels.title: 05 · BACKEND APPLICATION | Pino HTTP logs / Loki
HTTP requests · Selected period
panels.description: Count of Pino HTTP request logs during the selected period.

panels.title: HTTP 4xx errors · Selected period
panels.description: Client error responses (HTTP 4xx) during the selected period.

targets.expr: sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json statusCode="statusCode" | statusCode >= 400 | statusCode < 500 | __error__="" [$__range])) or vector(0)

panels.title: HTTP 5xx errors · Selected period
panels.description: Server error responses (HTTP 5xx) during the selected period.

panels.title: HTTP error rate · 4xx + 5xx
panels.description: Share of Pino HTTP requests with a 4xx or 5xx response.

targets.expr: 100 * ((sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json statusCode="statusCode" | statusCode >= 400 | __error__="" [$__range])) or vector(0)) / (sum(count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json event="event" | event="http_request" | __error__="" [$__range])) > 0)) or vector(0)

panels.title: Backend · Requests per minute
panels.description: Requests per minute, calculated from a five-minute rolling window.

panels.title: Backend · 4xx / 5xx errors per minute
panels.description: 4xx and 5xx HTTP errors per minute (five-minute rolling window). Zero is shown when there are no matching errors.

targets.expr: (sum(rate({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json statusCode="statusCode" | statusCode >= 400 | statusCode < 500 | __error__="" [5m])) or vector(0)) * 60

panels.title: Backend · P50 / P95 application response time
panels.description: Pino responseTimeMs measures Express application processing time, not full network response time or Render cold start.

targets.expr: quantile_over_time(0.50, {job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [15m]) by (job)
quantile_over_time(0.95, {job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json duration_ms="responseTimeMs" | unwrap duration_ms | __error__="" [15m]) by (job)

panels.title: Backend · HTTP status codes (5-minute window)
panels.description: HTTP response code counts per five-minute rolling window.

panels.title: Backend · Most requested API routes
panels.description: Top 10 application routes in the selected period. Route names are also shown in the legend.

targets.expr: topk(10, sum by (route) (count_over_time({job="matchwise_backend_render_api"} | json route="route" | route != "" | __error__="" [$__range])))

panels.title: 06 · LOG COLLECTOR | Collection and ingestion health
Collector · Seconds since last successful run
panels.description: Age of the last successful Render Logs API collection. It normally resets after each successful systemd run.

panels.title: Node Exporter textfile collector · Scrape errors
panels.description: 0 = Node Exporter textfile metrics parsed successfully; 1 = parsing error.

panels.title: 07 · DIAGNOSTICS | Detailed backend logs (click to expand)
Backend · HTTP logs (filter by Request ID)
panels.description: Pino HTTP request logs. Enter a Request ID in the dashboard variable to narrow the search.

panels.title: Backend · HTTP error logs (4xx/5xx)
panels.description: HTTP 4xx/5xx application logs. Enter a Request ID to filter.

list.name: request_id
list.label: Request ID (leave blank for all backend logs)
